title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Wanna Export Data to Excel in Analysis Mode?

chapters.title: Introduction to Data Analysis Export Features
Excel Export Methods - Right-Click and Menu Approaches
Improved File Naming for Excel Exports

features.name: Excel Export via Right-Click
features.description: Users can right-click in the data area of the data analysis tool and choose Excel export, then open in Excel to get their data exported.

features.name: Excel Export via Data Analysis Tab Menu
features.description: A new menu option on the data analysis tab allows users to simply choose open in Excel to export their data directly.

features.name: Improved Excel File Naming
features.description: The Excel export now provides improved file naming that includes the page name and analysis tab name rather than just using export as the file name.

quotes.text: if you like working with the data analysis tool in business Central we have a few new goodies for you
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates the focus of the video is on new features for the data analysis tool in Business Central.

quotes.text: in this release wave we made it a little bit easier the first method is simply if you right click in the data area
quotes.why_it_matters: Confirms that Excel export methods have been improved in the current release wave.

quotes.text: the other way which is in which is new is to use the menu here on the data analysis Tab and simply choose open
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that a new menu-based export method has been added to the data analysis tab.

quotes.text: you also get the file name of your Excel workbook uh with a name not not with the name export but with a name
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the improvement in file naming for exported Excel files, providing more descriptive names based on the page being used.

disclaimers.text: they're actually a bit old because they were backported to the current version but they are also available in the 2025 release Wave 1
